input.portfolio_risk_state: Current M123/M126/M127-compatible paper portfolio risk-state JSON
input.fill_marks: M117-compatible mark snapshot JSON for entry fill reference prices
input.loop_marks: One or more M117-compatible mark snapshot JSON files for post-fill mark-to-market

cycle_steps: Run M124 risk-gated execution-intent ledger from auto-ready items and current risk state.
Run M125 required portfolio-risk-gated paper router from pending intents.
Run M126 paper portfolio risk loop from simulated fills, marks, optional exits, and limits.
Emit a next-cycle M123-compatible paper portfolio risk-state JSON.

safety.description: M127 runs one paper-only cycle from risk-gated intents to simulated fills and next-cycle risk state. It does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
